at-lehre.name: Dual apprenticeship

facts.label: Leads to
facts.value: Upper secondary · access to higher education

at-lehre.story_title: What to expect on this scheme
story: You would most likely be between 15 and 18.
You would sign an apprenticeship contract and have the legal status of an apprentice.
You would spend most of your time (two-thirds or more) at the company.
You would earn a wage, set by collective agreements for your sector or by agreement with your employer, paid by your employer; it also covers your days at school.
It would take 2–4 years.
You would finish with: Apprenticeship certificate (Lehrabschluss), NQF 4, which gives direct access to higher education.
at-lehre.html:
CompanySchool

Mostly at work (≥2/3)

  • Pay Wage, paid by your employer
  • Arrangement Specific apprenticeship contract
  • Duration 2–4 yrs
  • Typical age 15–18
  • Leads to Upper secondary · access to higher education

What to expect on this scheme

You would most likely be between 15 and 18. You would sign an apprenticeship contract and have the legal status of an apprentice. You would spend most of your time (two-thirds or more) at the company. You would earn a wage, set by collective agreements for your sector or by agreement with your employer, paid by your employer; it also covers your days at school. It would take 2–4 years. You would finish with: Apprenticeship certificate (Lehrabschluss), NQF 4, which gives direct access to higher education.

facts.label: Leads to

befl-duaal.story_title: What to expect on this scheme
story: You would most likely be between 18 and 24.
Your training would be set out in a written arrangement (ordinary employment contract or specific apprenticeship contract).
You would spend about half your time at the company, switching between school and work every week.
You would earn a wage, set by law or by collective agreements for your sector, paid by your employer; it also covers your days at school.
It would take 1–2 school years per programme.
You would finish with: Secondary education diploma / vocational qualifications, NQF 2–4, which gives direct access to higher education.
